scope: Independent bounded source review only; no compilation, native execution, corpus work or timing

parserConditions: read-only adjacent expression or independent-reading raw body match

proofAndFallback.necessaryPrefixConditions: Equal definition-tag and rule raw token lengths plus their first up-to-four-byte signatures
proofAndFallback.selection: Newest first prefix match only; local prior_count becomes k+1 and local lookback becomes1
proofAndFallback.failedSelectedCandidate: Existing proof checks fail into ordinary strict glossary parsing; no retry of an older prefix candidate
proofAndFallback.proof: Existing bounds/opener/tail/middle/full-byte equality function unchanged; only a fully successful earlier row can donate hint/normalization metadata
proofAndFallback.rawMetadataAndRemainingFieldValidation: Late interner, numeric conversions, sequence/term-tags/row-close checks and key fallback paths remain unchanged
proofAndFallback.dedupNewestMatchArgument: Any newer skipped row fails a necessary header-content condition; if the selected witness also matches remaining content fields, it remains the newest full-content match.

statePolicy.reason: The caller refresh requires a witness AND its original lookback>0. The selector changes only callee-local bounds. Original four-match admission, four-miss budget and recent-content streak updates remain unchanged.
statePolicy.requiredDynamicCheck: Verify original match indexes/counters and old budget transitions under active repeated negative fixtures and experimental fallback modes.

limits: Source review does not establish speed, memory behavior or complete-import correctness.
The added helper may offer up to96 raw body bytes across3 bounded comparisons;32 is a per-comparison limit.
Prior original-streak admission requires active repeating negative controls; all-unique streams alone do not exercise it.
Compilation, focused/full semantic oracles, malformed/fallback/metadata cases, source-bound mechanics and independent timing remain outstanding.
